description: Shared type definitions for Open Gaming achievements, multi-component leaderboards, inline attestations, and genre extensions.

inlineSignature.description: An inline CID-first cryptographic attestation (compatible with the badge.blue / atproto-attestation specification). Computed over the DAG-CBOR CIDv1 of the parent record with `signatures` stripped and `$sig` injected containing `repository: <playerDid>` (and optional `rkey` when bound to a specific record key). Supports multi-issuer federation via `issuer`.

key.description: Verification method URI or DID key used to sign the attestation CID (e.g. `did:plc:gamepublisher#attestations`, `did:plc:communityhost#attestations`, or `did:key:z...`).

signature.description: Normalized low-S ECDSA signature bytes over the repository-bound attestation CIDv1 bytes.

issuer.description: Optional DID of the game publisher, tournament host, or community revival authority issuing the attestation.

issuedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the signature was generated.

rkey.description: Optional record key binding. When present, verifiers ensure the record resides at this exact `rkey`, preventing a player from moving a signed payload to a new `rkey` to evade URI-targeted ATProto moderation labels.

cid.description: Optional explicit copy of the computed attestation CIDv1 (`bafy...`) that was signed.

scoreFormat.description: Formatting rules for single-value integer leaderboard scores (modeled on Google Play Games Services score formatting, compatible with ATProto's integer-only data model).

kind.description: How raw integer scores should be interpreted for display.

decimalPlaces.description: Fixed decimal point offset for `numeric` or `currency` scores. For example, raw integer `314159` with `decimalPlaces: 2` displays as `3,141.59`.

timeUnit.description: Base integer unit for `time` leaderboards. For example, `66032` with `milliseconds` displays as `1:06.03`.

unitSingular.description: Optional custom singular unit label for `numeric` scores (e.g. `meter`, `pipe`, `like`, `pt`).

unitPlural.description: Optional custom plural unit label for `numeric` scores (e.g. `meters`, `pipes`, `likes`, `pts`).

enumOption.description: A named option in an `#enumComponentDef`, ordered from best (index 0) to worst unless `sortOrder` specifies otherwise.

id.description: Stable identifier for this enum value (e.g. `all-perfect`, `full-combo`, `clear`, `rank-s`).

pointsComponentDef.description: Defines an integer points/count component on a multi-component leaderboard (e.g. EX Score, Points, Collectibles, Max Combo).

percentageComponentDef.description: Defines a fixed-point percentage accuracy/completion component. Values are stored as integers scaled by `10^precision` (e.g. `precision: 2` and value `9942` displays as `99.42%`).

precision.description: Number of decimal places implied on the integer value.

maximum.description: Maximum valid scaled integer value (e.g. `10000` for `100.00%`, or `10100` for `101.00%`).

timeComponentDef.description: Defines an elapsed-time or survival-time component on a multi-component leaderboard.

enumComponentDef.description: Defines an ordered categorical component such as rhythm-game clear lamps (`ALL PERFECT`, `FULL COMBO`, `CLEAR`) or letter grades (`S`, `A`, `B`, `C`).

sortOrder.description: By default (`smallerIsBetter`), earlier entries in `values` (index 0) rank higher.

textComponentDef.description: Defines a display-only text metadata component (e.g. character, modifier list, or seed).

scoreComponentDefMap.description: Dictionary map of component key (`record-key` format, 1..32 chars, e.g. `ex-score`, `accuracy`, `lamp`, `clear-time`) to typed component definition. Uses the forward-compatible `$keyFormat`/`$valueType` Lexicon v1 object convention so existing PDS records and DAG-CBOR attestation CIDs require zero migration when the Lexicon `map` schema type ships.

$keyFormat.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` key validation (never written in records).

$valueType.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` value validation (never written in records).

pointsComponentVal.description: Integer points/count value matching a `#pointsComponentDef` entry under the same map key.

percentageComponentVal.description: Scaled fixed-point integer percentage value matching a `#percentageComponentDef` entry under the same map key.

timeComponentVal.description: Integer time duration value matching a `#timeComponentDef` entry under the same map key.

enumComponentVal.description: Enum option `id` matching an `#enumComponentDef` entry under the same map key.

textComponentVal.description: Display text value matching a `#textComponentDef` entry under the same map key.

scoreComponentValMap.description: Dictionary map of component key (`record-key` format, matching `leaderboard.definition#components`) to typed component value (`#pointsComponentVal`, `#percentageComponentVal`, `#timeComponentVal`, `#enumComponentVal`, `#textComponentVal`). Forward-compatible with the proposed Lexicon `map` type without changing wire data or DAG-CBOR attestation CIDs.

$keyFormat.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` key validation (never written in records).

$valueType.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` value validation (never written in records).

judgmentEntry.description: Timing judgment count for a single judgment window (e.g. `marvelous`, `perfect`, `great`, `good`, `miss`) in a rhythm or precision action game.

judgmentMap.description: Dictionary map of timing judgment key (`record-key` format, e.g. `marvelous`, `perfect`, `great`, `good`, `miss`) to `#judgmentEntry` counts, using the forward-compatible `$keyFormat`/`$valueType` Lexicon `map` convention.

$keyFormat.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` key validation (never written in records).

$valueType.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` value validation (never written in records).

judgmentBreakdown.description: Standardized Lexicon v1 judgment & input breakdown for rhythm/arcade runs (inspired by `dev.tsunagite.score`), attachable via `leaderboard.score#details`.

judgmentOrder.description: Optional explicit display order of judgment keys in `judgments` (e.g. `["marvelous", "perfect", "great", "miss"]`), preserving author-intended order across DAG-CBOR canonical map-key sorting.
